### Bible Pathways - May 9, 2009
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-may-9-2009-11603368.html
Passage: 2 Kings 21:2
Points:
- Manasseh rejected the godly legacy of his father Hezekiah to practice severe evil and idolatry.
- God permitted the Assyrians to conquer, bind, and intensely humiliate the rebellious king.
- In his affliction, Manasseh humbled himself and received the Lord's forgiving grace and restoration.
- Modern idols, like ancient false gods, tempt people to displace Christ as Lord in daily decisions.
- Although the Lord forgives the truly repentant, the destructive worldly consequences of past sins often remain.
